mapper.select: SELECT bd_mgt_sn AS buildingId, ST_Latitude(center) AS lat, ST_Longitude(center) AS lng, jibun_addr, road_addr, bld_nm, main_purps AS mainPurpsNm, grnd_flr, ugrnd_flr, use_apr_day FROM buildings WHERE MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText( CONCAT('POLYGON((', #{swLat}, ' ', #{swLng}, ',', #{swLat}, ' ', #{neLng}, ',', #{neLat}, ' ', #{neLng}, ',', #{neLat}, ' ', #{swLng}, ',', #{swLat}, ' ', #{swLng}, '))'), 4326), center) LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT bd_mgt_sn AS buildingId, bld_nm AS bldNm, main_purps AS mainPurpsNm, road_addr AS roadAddr, jibun_addr AS jibunAddr FROM buildings WHERE bd_mgt_sn = #{buildingId}
SELECT bd_mgt_sn AS buildingId, ST_Latitude(center) AS lat, ST_Longitude(center) AS lng FROM buildings WHERE pnu = #{pnu} LIMIT 1

SELECT bd_mgt_sn AS buildingId, ST_Latitude(center) AS lat, ST_Longitude(center) AS lng FROM buildings WHERE MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText( CONCAT('POLYGON((', #{lat} - 0.002, ' ', #{lng} - 0.002, ',', #{lat} - 0.002, ' ', #{lng} + 0.002, ',', #{lat} + 0.002, ' ', #{lng} + 0.002, ',', #{lat} + 0.002, ' ', #{lng} - 0.002, ',', #{lat} - 0.002, ' ', #{lng} - 0.002, '))'), 4326), center) ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(center, ST_SRID(POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)) LIMIT 1
SELECT bd_mgt_sn AS buildingId, ST_Latitude(center) AS lat, ST_Longitude(center) AS lng FROM buildings WHERE bld_nm LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(bld_nm) LIMIT 1
